sources_considered.why: A dated primary paper documents retrieval-conditioned image synthesis before the post.
A second independent model explicitly combines retrieval with text-to-image generation.
The conference version corroborates the first paper; the dated arXiv record supplies its publication history.

evidence_items.explanation: The paper describes functioning image synthesis conditioned on an external database, including transferring a trained model by changing that database. This directly contradicts the broad assertion that image-generation retrieval augmentation had not existed.

evidence_items.locator: Abstract; preceding sentences describe retrieval and conditioning
evidence_items.explanation: Re-Imagen retrieves relevant image-text pairs from an external knowledge base and uses them to generate images. Its reported evaluations establish an implemented system before January 2024, although they do not measure engineering difficulty against text RAG.

unresolved_gaps: These research systems do not establish whether the particular commercial image products discussed by Marcus used retrieval.
The cited studies do not provide a controlled comparison of implementation difficulty between image and text retrieval augmentation.
